title: Webhook delivery delay
briefing: Integration teams report missing webhook deliveries. Investigate the sender, queue, and external receiver.

actions.label: Check webhook retry backlog
actions.criteria: Use when retry jobs accumulate faster than the worker can drain them.
actions.instructions: Compare new retry enqueues with completed retry attempts and available workers.

actions.label: Inspect receiver TLS failures
actions.criteria: Use when external delivery attempts fail during certificate validation or TLS negotiation.
actions.instructions: Compare TLS error codes and receiver certificate chain metadata across failed deliveries.

actions.label: Compare webhook payload versions
actions.criteria: Use when response errors suggest the receiver rejects a changed request format.
actions.instructions: Compare the payload version and response status for recent accepted and rejected deliveries.

fallback: Collect the outcome of one failed attempt and the timestamp of its latest queued retry.

events.text: Delivery age exceeded 12 minutes. The aggregate alert includes all webhook tenants.
The retry queue grew from 30 to 2,100 pending attempts after 14:40. First-attempt and retry failure reasons have not reached the dashboard.

First and retry attempts to receiver group R17 all stop before HTTP negotiation. Certificate verification reports a missing intermediate for that group. Other receiver groups succeed with the same payload version.

debrief.summary: A receiver certificate chain was missing its intermediate. Repeated attempts grew the queue while the other receiver groups continued to accept deliveries.
lessons: Inspect the earliest failed network stage before investigating payload format.
Treat retry queue growth as a possible consequence of repeated transport errors.
